object: royal inscription of eighteen short lines of early writing inside a cartouche, engraved high on the pylon (front of the right-hand tower, by the passage-way)
site: Dakka (Pselchis), temple of Thoth of Pnubs, pylon (Lower Nubia)
notes: Griffith's copy from the original, November 1910, with Roeder's ladders; Pls. XII, XIII are from Berlin Academy photographs. Commentary: royal ('contained within a contemporary cartouche'); l. 2 has the royal title qore; l. 4 Akizaz (akidd), cf. Akinizaz in Meroe 2 and no. 93; perhaps three royalties, Naritaqas the king (nriTqs), Tarenas the queen and Akizaz the prince, or Aki(ni)zaz as sole ruler; 'trens, of tren' in l. 2 (cf. tren in 86), so tren(3)s is written as one word across the line number; l. 14 'adb'; l. 16 pelmoS 'strategus' with the affix -Nyi (cf. 94/4-7). Griffith also prints '?' over two dividers (the last of type line 1, and the one before k^e in l. 13), which cannot be marked here. In l. 14 the e-shaped half of the a of adbwi is in his square brackets (counted as read). kdke = Candace (queen). Spaces next to his line numbers are kept as printed except in tren(3)s.
